task_statement: Repair the public more_itertools.chunked API: it must be available from the package root, yield lists of n elements, keep a final partial list by default, and reject a partial list with strict=True. Trace the helper in recipes.py and the public export in more.py. Preserve tests and other iterable helpers. Verify with `python -m unittest discover -s checks`.
